Recovering your Solar System after Cyclone Alfred 

We hope you and your family are safe in the aftermath of Cyclone Alfred.  Here’s some important information to help you get back online with your Solar System

 🌪  Step 1: Inspection
• Check for visible damage from the ground, like cracked panels, shattered glass, or loose mounting. Do not get on the roof yourself, always ensure all visible damage is inspected from the ground only
• Inspect the Inverter—if it’s water-damaged or showing errors, leave it off

 ⚡️ Step 2: Electrical & Wiring
• Look for loose connections, exposed wires, or burn marks. Do not touch these yourself
• If you spot anything unusual, contact a licensed solar professional immediately

 🛠  Step 3: Call a Solar Expert
• Avoid DIY repairs—they can be dangerous and may void warranties.
• A professional inspection ensures your system is safe and operational

Handling Insurance & Repairs
 Document Everything – Take clear photos of any damage
 Review Your Policy – Understand your solar coverage and any exclusions".
